### Read in Data

original study: Single-cell RNA sequencing of murine liver reveals an aligned circadian clock and cell-population specific circadian regulated pathways by Veltri et al.\

<https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE29221>

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(Orpheus)
seurat_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object.Rds")

seurat_obj$seurat_clusters = seurat_obj$all_cell_types
```


Add ZT information to Seurat object:

```{r}
table(seurat_obj$orig.ident)

matches <- stringr::str_match(seurat_obj$orig.ident , "ZT(\\d+)$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
seurat_obj$ZT = ZT

table(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters, seurat_obj$orig.ident)
```

For identifying rhythms in this dataset we use BooteJTK. As in the original publication, we do a pseudoreplication scheme. Cells are assigned to one of two pseudoreplicates for each timepoint. We do this partitioning 4 independent times (folds) and consider rhythms only when they are significant in all four folds.

```{r}

for(i in seeds){
  message(paste("--- Running ORPHEUS with seed:", i, "---"))
    
    # returns a list like: list('CellTypeA' = ..., 'CellTypeB' = ...)
    results_one_seed <- calculate_orpheus_inputs(
      s_obj, 
      groups_to_analyze = unique(s_obj$seurat_clusters), 
      grouping_var = "seurat_clusters", 
      num_replicates = 2, 
      random_seed = i

    # prevents name clashes when we combine the lists.
    original_names <- names(results_one_seed)
    new_names <- paste0(original_names, "_seed", i)
    names(results_one_seed) <- new_names
    
    # Append the newly named results to main list
    all_results_combined <- c(all_results_combined, results_one_seed)
}
```

### What are reasonable params for my simulated data?

```{r}
s_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object_hepa_only_ORPHEUS_norm.Rds")

tmp = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = "hepatocytes 1", grouping_var = "seurat_clusters")


hep2 = tmp$`hepatocytes 1`
pb_mat = hep2[[1]]
var_mat = hep2[[2]]
counts = hep2[[3]]
dim(counts)

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
plot(log(means), log(vars))
theta_estimate = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
summary(theta_estimate$coarse_theta)
summary(means)

#Reasonable estimates for theta: 0.1 - 1.2
quantile(theta_estimate$coarse_theta, probs = c(0.05, .95))

#Reasonable range for gene means (G): 0.1 - 5
quantile(means, probs = c(0.05, .95))

cyclers = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
cyclers$p_statistic = as.numeric(cyclers$p_statistic)

#What fraction of genes should I make rhythmic? 0.10
sig_cyclers = dplyr::filter(cyclers, p_statistic < 0.05)
sig_cyclers %>% nrow / nrow(cyclers)

#Reasonable range for cycling amplitude_ratio?: 0.15 - 0.75
quantile(as.numeric(sig_cyclers$amp_ratio), probs = c(0.05, 0.95))

```

### BootEJTK

We will run pseudobulk and variance data through Bootejtk but we need to create the files for Bootetjk to use.

#### Prepare Pseudobulk for Bootejtk (all 4 subtypes)

```{r}
#Load all_results_combined
load("mouse_liver_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_hepatocytes_only_normed_list.RData")


write_bootejtk <- function(df, outfile) {
  # Ensure data frame with GeneID as first column
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  df <- cbind(GeneID = rownames(df), df)
  
  # Extract timepoints
  timepoints <- colnames(df)[-1]   # skip GeneID
  timepoints_clean = str_remove(timepoints, "_rep[0-9]+")
  # BooteJTK requires a header like:
  # #    ZT0   ZT4  ZT8 ...
  header <- paste0("#\t", paste0(timepoints_clean, collapse = "\t"))
  
  # Write header
  writeLines(header, con = outfile)
  
  # Append table
  write.table(
    df,
    file       = outfile,
    append     = TRUE,
    quote      = FALSE,
    sep        = "\t",
    row.names  = FALSE,
    col.names  = FALSE,
    na         = "NA"
  )
}


write_all_bootejtk <- function(nested_list, outdir) {
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)

  keep_list = c()
  # Determine which pb and var to keep based on if they have all timepoints
  for(i in 1:length(nested_list)){
    matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(nested_list[[i]][[1]]) , "ZT(\\d+)")
    ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
    if ( length(ZT)==12){
      if(all(ZT ==  rep(seq(3, 23, by = 4), each = 2))){
              keep_list = append(names(nested_list[i]), keep_list)
      }
  }
  }
  nested_list = nested_list[keep_list]
  all_tps = rep(seq(3, 23, by = 4), each = 2)
  
  for (name in names(nested_list)) {
    item <- nested_list[[name]]
    
    df1 <- item[[1]]
    matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(df1) , "ZT(\\d+)")
    ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
    stopifnot(ZT == all_tps)
    
    # Write dataframe to its own file
    outfile1 <- file.path(outdir, paste0(name, "_pb.txt"))

    write_bootejtk(df1, outfile1)
    # write_bootejtk(df2, outfile2)
  }
}
write_all_bootejtk(all_results_combined,"~/Desktop/mouse_liver_pb/")
```

#### Prepare variance signal for Bootejtk (all 4 subtypes)

Now we need to isolate the 12-hr rhythms in variance to give to ejtk. Below I use regression to isolate the 12-hr components of variance 3 ways: modeling the variance without any priors about phase, and 2) using the phase from ejtk on bulk data, and 3) using y \~ pb residuals. In cases 1 & 2, I subtract out the contribution of variance from the 24-hr rhythm and non-rhythm.

```{r}
prepare_var_for_ejtk <- function(times, var_mat, mean_mat, pb_phase_file, pb_cycling_sig_cutoff = 0.05) {
   cat(paste("\nPreparing variance data for eJTK, input times must be regularly spaced, e.g. 0-24 and in hrs units\n"))
   if(length(setdiff(unique(diff(times)), 0)) != 1){
     stop("Error: times must be regularly spaced in hrs units")
   }
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  pb_phases = read.delim(pb_phase_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  
  sig_genes = dplyr::filter(pb_phases, as.numeric(GammaP)< pb_cycling_sig_cutoff)
  
  keep_genes = sig_genes$ID %>% unname %>% unlist
  var_mat = var_mat[keep_genes,]
  mean_mat = mean_mat[keep_genes,]
  
  # Transpose matrices to have subjects x genes
  var_data <- t(var_mat)
  means1 <- t(mean_mat)
  times_rads = times * pi/12
  # Initialize matrices to store the double freq signals, mean rhythms
  double_freq_mat_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))

  double_freq_mat_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  
  double_freq_mat_residual <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # pb_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # var_mesor_values <- numeric(ncol(var_data))  # Store var_mesor for each gene
  rownames(double_freq_mat_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  
  rm_rows = c()
  # Loop through genes to calculate the double-frequency component, mean rhythm, and pseudobulk rhythm
  for (gene_i in 1:ncol(var_data)){
    gene_symbol = colnames(var_data)[gene_i]
    ejtk_bulk_phase = pb_phases$PhaseMean[pb_phases$ID == gene_symbol]
    ejtk_bulk_phase_rads = ejtk_bulk_phase * pi / 12
    stopifnot(ejtk_bulk_phase_rads >= 0 & ejtk_bulk_phase_rads <= 2*pi)
    stopifnot(rlang::is_empty(ejtk_bulk_phase) == FALSE)
    
    gexp1 <- as.numeric(unlist(var_data[, gene_i]))
    m1 <- as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))

    # Fit the variance model
    var_model_free <- lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2 *times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)
    design_matrix_free <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)


    double_wave = cos(2 * (times_rads- pi/2 - ejtk_bulk_phase_rads))
    var_model_fixed = lm(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    design_matrix_fixed <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    
    var_model_residual = lm(gexp1 ~ m1)


    sv <- svd(design_matrix_free)$d
    sv2 <- svd(design_matrix_fixed)$d
    tol <- 1e-14
    rankX <- sum(sv > tol)
    rankX2 <- sum(sv2 > tol)
    full <- ncol(design_matrix_free)
    full2 <- ncol(design_matrix_fixed)

    if (rankX < full || rankX2 < full2) {
      # design matrix is rank-deficient -> at least one coef would be NA
      # message(paste("Skipping gene", gene_symbol, "due to rank-deficient design matrix"))
      rm_rows = append(gene_i, rm_rows)
    }

    if (var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_residual$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0) {
      # If the coefficient for m1 is negative, skip this gene
      # message(paste("Skipping gene", colnames(var_data)[gene_i], "due to mean coefficient < 0 in variance model"))
    rm_rows = append(gene_i, rm_rows)

    } else {  
    # var_mesor <- mean(var_model_free$fitted.values)
    var_mesor_free <- mean(design_matrix_free[,-c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2,3)])
    var_mesor_fixed <- mean(design_matrix_fixed[,-2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2])
    # var_mesor_values[gene_i] <- var_mesor  # Store var_mesor for this gene

    # Calculate the double frequency signal (double-frequency component)
    circ <- gexp1 - design_matrix_free[, -c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2, 3)]
    double_freq_mat_free[gene_i, ] <- circ

    circ_fixed <- gexp1 - design_matrix_fixed[, -2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2]
    double_freq_mat_fixed[gene_i, ] <- circ_fixed
  
    double_freq_mat_residual[gene_i, ] <- var_model_residual$residuals
    
    # Calculate the mean rhythm
    mean_rhythm <- var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_free[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm

    mean_rhythm_fixed <- var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm_fixed

    # Calculate the pseudobulk rhythm (just m1)
    # pb_mat[gene_i, ] <- m1
    }
  }
  rm_rows = unique(rm_rows)
  rm_genes = rownames(double_freq_mat_free)[rm_rows]
  double_freq_mat_free = double_freq_mat_free[-rm_rows,]
  double_freq_mat_fixed = double_freq_mat_fixed[-rm_rows,]
  mean_rhythm_matrix_free = mean_rhythm_matrix_free[-rm_rows, ]
  mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed = mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed[-rm_rows,]
  double_freq_mat_residual = double_freq_mat_residual[-rm_rows,]
  
  
  return(list(double_freq_mat_free = double_freq_mat_free, double_freq_mat_fixed = double_freq_mat_fixed, fund_rhythm_matrix_free = mean_rhythm_matrix_free, fund_rhythm_matrix_fixed = mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed, double_freq_mat_residual = double_freq_mat_residual, rm_genes = rm_genes))
}
```

```{r}

plot_free_acrodiff_ejtk = function(cell_type, var_sig = 0.05){
  pb_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepa_only_normed/mouse_liver_pb/ejtk_pb_results/",cell_type, "_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
    var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepa_only_normed/liver_targeted12rhythms_fixedAcroRegression_AllhrWidth/bashLoop_", cell_type, "_targeted_results_fixedAcroRegression_ALLhr_width.txt")

  pb_jtk_res = read.delim(pb_path, sep = "\t")
  var_jtk_res = read.delim(var_path, sep = "\t")

  merged_res = merge(pb_jtk_res, var_jtk_res, by.x = "ID", by.y = "Gene", suffixes = c("_pb", "_var"))

  merged_filt = dplyr::filter(merged_res, Pvalue < var_sig) %>% mutate(acrodiff = (PhaseMean12 - PhaseMean) %% 12)

 # hist(merged_filt$acrodiff, main = cell_type, breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 2))
 cell_type_str = str_remove(cell_type, "_seed.*")
 fill_col <- switch(
  cell_type_str,
  "pericentral hepatocytes" = "#F8766D",
  "periportal hepatocytes" = "#F0E442",
  "hepatocytes 1" = "#E69F00",
  "hepatocytes 2" = "#56B4E9"
)
 
acrodiff_compare = ggplot(merged_filt, aes(x = acrodiff)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, color = "black", alpha = 1,  breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 2), fill = fill_col) +
  guides(fill = "none") +    # remove fill legend
  xlab("abs(24hr PB acro - 12hr Var acro)(hrs)")+
  ylab("Count")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase x-axis text size
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)    # Increase legend title size
  )+
   # Use scale_x_continuous for precise control over the x-axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 12),
    breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 3)
  )+ggtitle(cell_type)

show(acrodiff_compare)
ggsave(paste0("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_acrodiff_plots/", cell_type, "_acrodiff.pdf"), plot = acrodiff_compare, width = 5, height = 3)
}
```

### ORPHEUS, using the genes provided by BootEJTK

Given significant cyclers from Bootejtk on pseudobulk, and targeted 12-hr rhythms in variance, run regression to get rhythmic parameters, ignoring any significance cutoffs from regression. I will use the pseudobulk data from all cells not pseudoreplicates here.

```{r}
cell_types = c("hepatocytes 1", "hepatocytes 2", "periportal hepatocytes", "pericentral hepatocytes")

filenames <- as.vector(outer(cell_types, paste0("_seed", 1:4), paste0))

var_p_value = 0.05

#Find the genes to test from Bootejtk. This will be the intersection of all folds:
sig_ejtk_genes <- list()
for(cell_type in filenames){
  var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepa_only_normed/liver_targeted12rhythms_fixedAcroRegression_2hrWidth/bashLoop_", cell_type, "_targeted_results_FixedAcroRegression_2hr_width.txt")
  bejtk_var_res = read.delim(var_path)
  pb_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepa_only_normed/mouse_liver_pb/ejtk_pb_results/", cell_type, "_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
  bejtk_pb_res = read.delim(pb_path)
  
  merged_res = merge(bejtk_var_res, bejtk_pb_res, by.x = "Gene", by.y = "ID", suffixes = c("_var", "_pb")) %>% filter(Pvalue < var_p_value & GammaP < 0.05) %>% mutate(acrodiff = (PhaseMean12 - PhaseMean) %% 12)
  merged_res$Source = cell_type
  
  sig_ejtk_genes[[cell_type]] = merged_res
}
```

#### Plot some example gene traces

This plots the data given to Bootejtk (4 cell types 1st fold), selecting the 3 most significant 12-hr rhythms from the Bootejtk (targeting all phases) analysis. The idea is, of the most significant 12-hr rhythms, the acrophase of the 24-hr rhythm is \~6 or 12 hr different

```{r}
library(doParallel)
plot_rhythms <- function(cell_type, times, var_mat, mean_mat, plot_me = c(), time_units = "hrs", line_thickness = 1, point_size = 3, line_color = "red", point_color = "blue") {
  gene1 <- t(var_mat)  # get the transpose, subjects x genes and put in order of CYCLOPS order
  means1 <- t(mean_mat)
  
  if (time_units == "hrs") {
    cat(paste("\nRunning regression, converting hours to radians"))
    times1 <- times / 12 * pi
  } else {
    cat(paste("\nRunning regression assuming times are 0-2pi radians"))
    times1 <- times
  }
  times1_hrs = times1 * 12 / pi
  
  # Subset to selected genes, ensuring matrices remain matrices
  gene1 <- gene1[, colnames(gene1) %in% plot_me, drop = FALSE]
  means1 <- means1[, colnames(means1) %in% plot_me, drop = FALSE]

  # Loop through genes
  foreach(gene_i = 1:ncol(gene1), .combine = rbind) %do% {
    gexp1 <- as.numeric(unlist(gene1[, gene_i]))
    m1 <- as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))
    Gene_Symbols <- colnames(gene1)[gene_i]
    pb_model_partial = lm(m1~ 1)
    pb_model <- lm(m1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1))
    pb_anova_results = anova(pb_model_partial, pb_model)
    pb_acro = atan2(pb_model[["coefficients"]][["sin(times1)"]], pb_model[["coefficients"]][["cos(times1)"]]) %% (2*pi)
    pb_acro_hrs = pb_acro * 12 / pi
    pb_amp = sqrt(pb_model[["coefficients"]][["sin(times1)"]]^2 + pb_model[["coefficients"]][["cos(times1)"]]^2)
    pb_intercept = pb_model[['coefficients']]["(Intercept)"]

    var_partial <- lm(gexp1 ~ 1)
    var_model <- lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times1) + cos(2 * times1) )
    var_anova_results = anova(var_partial, var_model)
    sin_coeff = var_model[["coefficients"]][["sin(2 * times1)"]]
    cos_coeff = var_model[["coefficients"]][["cos(2 * times1)"]]
    double_freq_acrophase = atan2(sin_coeff, cos_coeff) %% (2*pi) / 2
    double_freq_acrophase_hrs = double_freq_acrophase * 12 / pi
    var_double_freq_amp = sqrt(sin_coeff^2 + cos_coeff^2)

    my_theme <- theme_bw()+
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),#  x-axis text size
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),#  y-axis text size
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),#  x-axis title size
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),#  y-axis title size
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12), # legend title size
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
      )

   # Data for plot 1 
    pb_data <- data.frame(times1_hrs = times1_hrs, m1 = m1) 
    times_ideal <- seq(0, round(max(times1_hrs)), by = 0.1) 
    pb_ideal_data <- data.frame(times_ideal = times_ideal, 
                            pb_ideal = pb_amp * cos((times_ideal - pb_acro_hrs)*(pi/12)) + pb_intercept) 

    # Create the ggplot object 
    p1 <- ggplot(pb_data, aes(x = times1_hrs, y = m1)) + 
    geom_point(color = point_color, size = point_size) + 
    geom_line(data = pb_ideal_data, aes(x = times_ideal, y = pb_ideal), color = line_color, linewidth = line_thickness) + 
    labs(title = paste(cell_type, "PB", Gene_Symbols), 
          subtitle = paste("p-value:", round(pb_anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2], 3), 
                          ", acrophase:", round(pb_acro_hrs, 3)), 
          x = "Time (hrs)", 
          y = "Bulk expression")+
    my_theme

    # Data for plot 2 
    var_data <- data.frame(times1_hrs = times1_hrs, circ = gexp1) 
    var_ideal_data <- data.frame(times_ideal = times_ideal, 
                              var_ideal = var_double_freq_amp * cos(2 *(pi/12)*(times_ideal - double_freq_acrophase_hrs))) 

    # Create the ggplot object 
    p2 <- ggplot(var_data, aes(x = times1_hrs, y = circ)) + 
    geom_point(color = point_color, size = point_size) + 
    geom_line(data = var_ideal_data, aes(x = times_ideal, y = var_ideal), color = line_color, linewidth = line_thickness) + 
    labs(title = paste(cell_type, "12hr comp.", Gene_Symbols), 
    subtitle = paste("p-value:", round(var_anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2], 3), ", acrophase:", round(double_freq_acrophase_hrs, 3)), x = "Time (hrs)", 
y = "12-hr component of var.")+
    my_theme
    show(p1+p2)
    combined_plot <- p1 + p2
    ggsave(paste0("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_gene_traces/", cell_type,"_", Gene_Symbols,".pdf"), combined_plot, width = 7, height = 5)

    }
}

cell_types = c("hepatocytes 1", "hepatocytes 2", "periportal hepatocytes", "pericentral hepatocytes")
```

#### Prepare Pseudobulk for Bootejtk (hepatocytes combined)

```{r}
#######Load results from above #######
load("figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/hepatocytes_combined_2pseudoreps4folds_pb_var_counts_list.RData")

write_bootejtk <- function(df, outfile) {
  # Ensure data frame with GeneID as first column
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  df <- cbind(GeneID = rownames(df), df)
  
  # Extract timepoints
  timepoints <- colnames(df)[-1]   # skip GeneID
  timepoints_clean = str_remove(timepoints, "_rep[0-9]+")
  # BooteJTK requires a header like:
  # #    ZT0   ZT4  ZT8 ...
  header <- paste0("#\t", paste0(timepoints_clean, collapse = "\t"))
  
  # Write header
  writeLines(header, con = outfile)
  
  # Append table
  write.table(
    df,
    file       = outfile,
    append     = TRUE,
    quote      = FALSE,
    sep        = "\t",
    row.names  = FALSE,
    col.names  = FALSE,
    na         = "NA"
  )
}


write_all_bootejtk <- function(nested_list, outdir) {
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)

  keep_list = c()
  # Determine which pb and var to keep based on if they have all timepoints
  for(i in 1:length(nested_list)){
    matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(nested_list[[i]][[1]]) , "ZT(\\d+)")
    ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
    if ( length(ZT)==12){
      if(all(ZT ==  rep(seq(3, 23, by = 4), each = 2))){
              keep_list = append(names(nested_list[i]), keep_list)
      }
  }
  }
  nested_list = nested_list[keep_list]
  all_tps = rep(seq(3, 23, by = 4), each = 2)
  
  for (name in names(nested_list)) {
    item <- nested_list[[name]]
    
    df1 <- item[[1]]
    matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(df1) , "ZT(\\d+)")
    ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
    stopifnot(ZT == all_tps)
    
    # Write dataframe to its own file
    outfile1 <- file.path(outdir, paste0(name, "_pb.txt"))

    write_bootejtk(df1, outfile1)
    # write_bootejtk(df2, outfile2)
  }
}
write_all_bootejtk(hepatocyte_pb_var,"~/Desktop/mouse_liver_pb_hepa_combined/")
```

#### Prepare variance signal for Bootejtk (hepatocytes combined)

```{r}
prepare_var_for_ejtk <- function(times, var_mat, mean_mat, pb_phase_file, pb_cycling_sig_cutoff = 0.05) {
   cat(paste("\nPreparing variance data for eJTK, input times must be regularly spaced, e.g. 0-24 and in hrs units\n"))
   if(length(setdiff(unique(diff(times)), 0)) != 1){
     stop("Error: times must be regularly spaced in hrs units")
   }
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  pb_phases = read.delim(pb_phase_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  
  sig_genes = dplyr::filter(pb_phases, as.numeric(GammaP)< pb_cycling_sig_cutoff)
  
  keep_genes = sig_genes$ID %>% unname %>% unlist
  var_mat = var_mat[keep_genes,]
  mean_mat = mean_mat[keep_genes,]
  
  # Transpose matrices to have subjects x genes
  var_data <- t(var_mat)
  means1 <- t(mean_mat)
  times_rads = times * pi/12
  # Initialize matrices to store the double freq signals, mean rhythms
  double_freq_mat_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))

  double_freq_mat_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  
  double_freq_mat_residual <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # pb_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # var_mesor_values <- numeric(ncol(var_data))  # Store var_mesor for each gene
  rownames(double_freq_mat_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  
  rm_rows = c()
  # Loop through genes to calculate the double-frequency component, mean rhythm, and pseudobulk rhythm
  for (gene_i in 1:ncol(var_data)){
    gene_symbol = colnames(var_data)[gene_i]
    ejtk_bulk_phase = pb_phases$PhaseMean[pb_phases$ID == gene_symbol]
    ejtk_bulk_phase_rads = ejtk_bulk_phase * pi / 12
    stopifnot(ejtk_bulk_phase_rads >= 0 & ejtk_bulk_phase_rads <= 2*pi)
    stopifnot(rlang::is_empty(ejtk_bulk_phase) == FALSE)
    
    gexp1 <- as.numeric(unlist(var_data[, gene_i]))
    m1 <- as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))

    # Fit the variance model
    var_model_free <- lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2 *times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)
    design_matrix_free <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)


    double_wave = cos(2 * (times_rads- pi/2 - ejtk_bulk_phase_rads))
    var_model_fixed = lm(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    design_matrix_fixed <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    
    var_model_residual = lm(gexp1 ~ m1)


    sv <- svd(design_matrix_free)$d
    sv2 <- svd(design_matrix_fixed)$d
    tol <- 1e-14
    rankX <- sum(sv > tol)
    rankX2 <- sum(sv2 > tol)
    full <- ncol(design_matrix_free)
    full2 <- ncol(design_matrix_fixed)

    if (rankX < full || rankX2 < full2) {
      # design matrix is rank-deficient -> at least one coef would be NA
      # message(paste("Skipping gene", gene_symbol, "due to rank-deficient design matrix"))
      rm_rows = append(gene_i, rm_rows)
    }

    if (var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_residual$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0) {
      # If the coefficient for m1 is negative, skip this gene
      # message(paste("Skipping gene", colnames(var_data)[gene_i], "due to mean coefficient < 0 in variance model"))
    rm_rows = append(gene_i, rm_rows)

    } else {  
    # var_mesor <- mean(var_model_free$fitted.values)
    var_mesor_free <- mean(design_matrix_free[,-c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2,3)])
    var_mesor_fixed <- mean(design_matrix_fixed[,-2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2])
    # var_mesor_values[gene_i] <- var_mesor  # Store var_mesor for this gene

    # Calculate the double frequency signal (double-frequency component)
    circ <- gexp1 - design_matrix_free[, -c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2, 3)]
    double_freq_mat_free[gene_i, ] <- circ

    circ_fixed <- gexp1 - design_matrix_fixed[, -2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2]
    double_freq_mat_fixed[gene_i, ] <- circ_fixed
  
    double_freq_mat_residual[gene_i, ] <- var_model_residual$residuals
    
    # Calculate the mean rhythm
    mean_rhythm <- var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_free[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm

    mean_rhythm_fixed <- var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm_fixed

    # Calculate the pseudobulk rhythm (just m1)
    # pb_mat[gene_i, ] <- m1
    }
  }
  rm_rows = unique(rm_rows)
  rm_genes = rownames(double_freq_mat_free)[rm_rows]
  double_freq_mat_free = double_freq_mat_free[-rm_rows,]
  double_freq_mat_fixed = double_freq_mat_fixed[-rm_rows,]
  mean_rhythm_matrix_free = mean_rhythm_matrix_free[-rm_rows, ]
  mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed = mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed[-rm_rows,]
  double_freq_mat_residual = double_freq_mat_residual[-rm_rows,]
  
  
  return(list(double_freq_mat_free = double_freq_mat_free, double_freq_mat_fixed = double_freq_mat_fixed, fund_rhythm_matrix_free = mean_rhythm_matrix_free, fund_rhythm_matrix_fixed = mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed, double_freq_mat_residual = double_freq_mat_residual, rm_genes = rm_genes))
}

outdir = "~/Desktop/test/"
for(cell_type in names(hepatocyte_pb_var)){
  message(cell_type)
  pb_mat = hepatocyte_pb_var[[cell_type]]$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix
  var_mat = hepatocyte_pb_var[[cell_type]]$var_df
  sample_times = stringr::str_remove(colnames(pb_mat),"ZT") %>%
                stringr::str_remove(., "_rep[0-9]+") %>%
                as.numeric
  if(length(setdiff(unique(diff(sample_times)), 0)) != 1){
     message(cell_type, " has irregular sample times, skipping.")
    next
   }
  pb_filename = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepatocytes_combined/hepatocytes_combined_pb/ejtk_pb_results/",cell_type,"_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
  if(!file.exists(pb_filename)){
    next
  }
  output_dfs = prepare_var_for_ejtk(sample_times, var_mat, pb_mat, pb_filename)
  
  # Get row names of the first data frame
  first_df_rownames <- rownames(output_dfs[[1]])
  
  # Check if all data frames have the same row names as the first
  all_same_rownames <- all(sapply(output_dfs[-6], function(df) identical(rownames(df), first_df_rownames)))
  
  stopifnot(all_same_rownames)

  
 for (name in names(output_dfs)[-6]) {
    item <- output_dfs[[name]]
    safe_name = stringr::str_replace(name, "/", "")
    # Write each dataframe to its own file
    outfile1 <- file.path(outdir, paste0(cell_type,'_', safe_name,".txt"))
    write_bootejtk(item, outfile1)
 }
  outfile2 <- file.path(outdir, paste0("rm_genes_negative_mean_coeff_", cell_type,".txt"))

 write.table(output_dfs[6], outfile2, sep = ",", row.names = F, col.names = F)

}
```

#### Orpheus, on hepatocytes combined, using genes provided by BootEJTK

```{r}
cell_types = c("hepatocyte")

filenames <- as.vector(outer(cell_types, paste0("_seed", 1:4), paste0))

var_p_value = 0.05

#Find the genes to test from Bootejtk. This will be the intersection of all folds:
sig_ejtk_genes <- list()
for(cell_type in filenames){
  var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepatocytes_combined/liver_targeted12rhythms_fixedAcroRegression_2hrWidth/bashLoop_", cell_type, "_targeted_results_fixedAcroRegression_2hr_width.txt")
  bejtk_var_res = read.delim(var_path)
  pb_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepatocytes_combined/hepatocytes_combined_pb/ejtk_pb_results/", cell_type, "_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
  bejtk_pb_res = read.delim(pb_path)
  
  merged_res = merge(bejtk_var_res, bejtk_pb_res, by.x = "Gene", by.y = "ID", suffixes = c("_var", "_pb")) %>% filter(Pvalue < var_p_value & GammaP < 0.05) %>% mutate(acrodiff = (PhaseMean12 - PhaseMean) %% 12)
  merged_res$Source = cell_type
  
  sig_ejtk_genes[[cell_type]] = merged_res
}
sig_ejtk_genes_df <- bind_rows(sig_ejtk_genes) %>%
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed")

consensus_sig_ejtk_genes_df = sig_ejtk_genes_df %>%
  group_by(cell, Gene) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)

consensus_unique <- consensus_sig_ejtk_genes_df %>%
  select(cell, Gene, n_seeds) %>%
  distinct()

table(consensus_unique$cell)
ejtk_genes_for_orph = consensus_unique$Gene
# save(ejtk_genes_for_orph, file ="figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/hepatocyte_ejtk_genes_to_calc_phi.RData")

### We will test these genes in the full data (not pseudoreps) ###

#      )
# save(orpheus_inputs, file = "figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/hepatocytes_combined_NOpseudoreps_pb_var_counts_list.RData")
load("figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/hepatocytes_combined_NOpseudoreps_pb_var_counts_list.RData")

### Loop through pb and var and call ORPHEUS calc_phi ###
#No longer needs to be a for loop but keeping so legacy code can run without problem:
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in c("hepatocyte")){
# cell_type_str = str_remove(cell_type, "/")
message("Looking at celltype: ", cell_type)
ejtk_sig_genes = consensus_unique %>% filter(cell == cell_type) %>% select(Gene) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
tmp = orpheus_inputs[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

stopifnot(all(ejtk_sig_genes %in% rownames(pb_mat)))

#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
# print(ZT)


pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")


phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)
var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))
var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.5

input_cos = var_cyclers %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    #mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% ejtk_sig_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

 # Calculate phi parameters
phi = input_cos %>%
        apply(., 1, function(row) {
            suppressWarnings(

                 )

        t %>%

colnames(phi) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")
output = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))

}

}))
```

#### enrichR

```{r}
library(enrichR)

load("./figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/orpheus_results_hepatocytes_combined_ejtk_list_to_regression.RData")
cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.na(phi) & as.numeric(fund_mean_coeff) > 0)

dbs <- c("MSigDB_Hallmark_2020") #, "KEGG_2019_Mouse", "KEGG_2021_Human", "WikiPathways_2024_Mouse", "Reactome_Pathways_2024")

run_enrichR = function(phi_df, dbs, prop = 0.5){
  websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live")
  
  top_frac = arrange(phi_df, phi) %>% slice_head(prop = prop) %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  bottom_frac = arrange(phi_df, phi) %>% slice_tail(prop = prop) %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  background = phi_df %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  if (websiteLive) {
      # Replace 'Rank' with 'Overlap' column, calculated with GMT files
      synchronized<- enrichr(top_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      synchronized_df = do.call(rbind, synchronized) %>% arrange(P.value)
      synchronized_df$group = "synch"
      unsynch <-enrichr(bottom_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      unsynch_df = do.call(rbind, unsynch) %>% arrange(P.value)
      unsynch_df$group = "unsynch"

     return(rbind(synchronized_df, unsynch_df))
  }
  
}

pathway_results = run_enrichR(cos_phis_tmm_filt, dbs = dbs, prop = 0.5)

save(pathway_results, file ="./figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/enrichR_top_and_bottom_half_phi_overrepresentation.RData")
```

```{r}
      # Replace 'Rank' with 'Overlap' column, calculated with GMT files
      synchronized<- enrichr(top_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      synchronized_df = do.call(rbind, synchronized) %>% arrange(P.value)
      synchronized_df$group = "synch"
      unsynch <-enrichr(bottom_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      unsynch_df = do.call(rbind, unsynch) %>% arrange(P.value)
      unsynch_df$group = "unsynch"

     return(rbind(synchronized_df, unsynch_df))
  }
  
}

pathway_results = cos_phis_tmm_filt %>% group_by(Source) %>% group_modify(~run_enrichR(.x, dbs, prop = 0.5))

save(pathway_results, file ="./figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_4_subtypes_different_genes/HepaCombinedEjtkGenes_on_4_subtypes/enrichR_top_and_bottom_half_phi_overrepresentation.RData")
```

#### Create Empirical Dist

These cells are comparable via our boostrapping procedure: We will shuffle the hepatocyte label 1000 times and re-calculate phi in each shuffled label to see if there are significant cell-type differences.

```{r}

s_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object_hepa_only_ORPHEUS_norm.Rds")

set.seed(1234)

n_boots = 1000
n_cells = 32515 #ncol(s_obj)
labels = unname(unlist(s_obj$seurat_clusters))
perm_mat <- replicate(n_boots, sample(labels))
rownames(perm_mat) = colnames(s_obj)
###########################

stopifnot(all(colnames(s_obj) == rownames(perm_mat)))

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Loop through all the perms and create pb and variance matrices for each,
#We will store these so I only have to do it once.
pb_var_list <- vector("list", n_boots)
names(pb_var_list) <- paste0("V", seq(1,n_boots))

for(i in 1:n_boots){
  message("Analyzing Perm ", i)
  print(table(perm_mat[,i]))

  shuffled_labels <- perm_mat[, i]
  stopifnot(all.equal(colnames(s_obj), names(shuffled_labels)))
  s_obj$shuffled_labels <- shuffled_labels
  
  orpheus_input_i = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = unique(s_obj$shuffled_labels), grouping_var = "shuffled_labels")

  orpheus_input_sans_counts <- lapply(orpheus_input_i, function(x) x[-3])
  pb_var_list[[i]] <- orpheus_input_sans_counts
  
  rm(orpheus_input_i)
  gc()
  
}
save(pb_var_list, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_liver_hepaCombinedGenes_to_subtypes_pb_var_list_nullData_1000perms.RData")
```

#### Calculate Significance from empirical dist

```{r}
load("figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/causal_pathway_analysis_gsva/null_dist_quartiles/mouse_liver_null_dist_phi_outputs_quartiles.RData")

any(table(names(phi_outputs)) !=1)

null_data_phis_df <- imap_dfr(phi_outputs, ~ mutate(.x, pathway = .y)) %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(Source, levels = c("Q1_low","Q2_midlow", "Q3_midhigh", "Q4_high")))

#Unpaired version:
null_stats_df <- null_data_phis_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(phi) & fund_mean_coeff > 0) %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    n_low = sum(Source == "Q1_low"),
    n_midlow = sum(Source == "Q2_midlow"),
    n_midhigh = sum(Source == "Q3_midhigh"),
    n_high = sum(Source == "Q4_high"),
    #p_value = wilcox.test(phi ~ Source)$p.value,
    #statistic = wilcox.test(phi ~ Source)$statistic,
    med_low = median(phi[Source == "Q1_low"]),
    med_midlow = median(phi[Source == "Q2_midlow"]),
    med_midhigh = median(phi[Source == "Q3_midhigh"]),
    med_high = median(phi[Source == "Q4_high"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% #mutate(normed_stat = statistic/(n_low*n_high)) %>%
  mutate(med_diff = med_high - med_low) %>%
  mutate(abs_med_diff = abs(med_diff))

cutoffs = quantile(null_stats_df$abs_med_diff, probs = c(0.95, 0.99))

load("figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/causal_pathway_analysis_gsva/hallmark_quartiles_noCosineGSVAscoreFilter/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathway_phis.RData")

real_pathway_phis_df <- imap_dfr(phi_outputs, ~ mutate(.x, pathway = .y)) %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(Source, levels = c("Q1_low","Q2_midlow", "Q3_midhigh", "Q4_high")))

#Unpaired version:
real_stats_df <- real_pathway_phis_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(phi) & fund_mean_coeff > 0) %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    n_low = sum(Source == "Q1_low"),
    n_midlow = sum(Source == "Q2_midlow"),
    n_midhigh = sum(Source == "Q3_midhigh"),
    n_high = sum(Source == "Q4_high"),
    #p_value = wilcox.test(phi ~ Source)$p.value,
    #statistic = wilcox.test(phi ~ Source)$statistic,
    med_low = median(phi[Source == "Q1_low"]),
    med_midlow = median(phi[Source == "Q2_midlow"]),
    med_midhigh = median(phi[Source == "Q3_midhigh"]),
    med_high = median(phi[Source == "Q4_high"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% #mutate(normed_stat = statistic/(n_low*n_high)) %>%
  mutate(med_diff = med_high - med_low) %>%
  mutate(abs_med_diff = abs(med_diff)) %>%
  mutate(sig_05 = ifelse(abs_med_diff > cutoffs[1], T, F)) %>%
  mutate(sig_01 = ifelse(abs_med_diff > cutoffs[2], T, F))


p_empirical <- function(x, null_vec) {
  (sum(null_vec >= x) + 1) / (length(null_vec) + 1)
}
real_stats_df$p_value <- sapply(real_stats_df$abs_med_diff, p_empirical, null_vec = null_stats_df$abs_med_diff)

real_stats_df$BHQ = p.adjust(real_stats_df$p_value, method = "BH")

# write.table(real_stats_df, file = "./figures/mouse_liver_clean/Bootejtk_hepatocytes_combined/causal_pathway_analysis_gsva/hallmark_quartiles_noCosineGSVAscoreFilter/quartiles_pathways_significance_result.csv", sep = ",", row.names = F)
```

### Are fraction of hepatocyte subtypes rhythmic?

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(Seurat)
s_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object_hepa_only_ORPHEUS_norm.Rds")

cell_prop_v_time_long = s_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters, orig.ident)%>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(orig.ident)%>%
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count))

cell_prop_v_time =  cell_prop_v_time_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = -count, names_from = orig.ident, values_from = prop)%>% column_to_rownames(var = "seurat_clusters")

#Alternative way of doing this, for practice
# cell_count_v_time = table(s_obj$seurat_clusters, s_obj$orig.ident)
# sums = colSums(cell_count_v_time)
# cell_prop_v_time2 = sweep(as.matrix(cell_count_v_time), 2, sums, FUN = "/") %>% as.matrix

ZT = colnames(cell_prop_v_time) %>% str_remove(.,"ZT") %>% as.numeric
times_rad = ZT * pi / 12

results = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(cell_prop_v_time), ncol = 2)
for(i in 1:nrow(cell_prop_v_time)){
  prop_i = unname(unlist(cell_prop_v_time[i,]))
  base = lm(prop_i ~ 1)
  full = lm(prop_i ~ sin(times_rad) + cos(times_rad))
  anova_res = anova(base, full)
  p_val = anova_res$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  results[i, 1] = rownames(cell_prop_v_time)[i]
  results[i, 2] = p_val
}
results = as.data.frame(results) 
colnames(results) = c("cell_type", "p_value")
results$BHQ = p.adjust(results$p_value, method = "BH")

color_palette <- c("cholangiocytes" = "#883923", "endothelial cells 1" = "#E68613", "hepatocytes 1" = "#E69F00", "hepatocytes 2" = "#56B4E9", "kupffer cells" = "#00BFC4", "pericentral hepatocytes" = "#F8766D", "periportal hepatocytes" = "#F0E442")

p2 = ggplot(cell_prop_v_time_long, aes(x = as.numeric(str_remove(orig.ident, "ZT")), y = prop, color = seurat_clusters, group = seurat_clusters))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
    scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +
  labs(color = "Hepatocyte type", x = "ZT", y = "Prop of hepatocytes")+
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )

ggsave("~/Desktop/prop_hepatocytes_v_time.pdf", p2, width = 5, height = 3)
```
